faits.fait: Sévéane is a care network born from an agreement between Groupama and PRO BTP. Korelio is the services network created by PRO BTP for exchanges with health professionals, including third-party payment (tiers payant: the patient pays nothing upfront, insurers pay the provider directly).
Sévéane is a simplified joint-stock company (SAS) owned in equal shares by Groupama Assurances Mutuelles and BTP-Prévoyance, registered in May 2022. It absorbed the Sévéane GIE on January 1, 2023.
BTP-Prévoyance acts for Groupe PRO BTP and for all the organizations that use Korelio optical third-party payment.
Organizations that have entrusted their third-party payment to Korelio: BTP-Prévoyance, SAF BTP IARD, MBBTP, SMABTP, Auxiliaire, MGI, Prodigéo Assurances, Audiens and Mutuelle Mieux-Être.
On the Korelio third-party payment card, opticians carry the code “OPTI”. Coverage approval is done on korelio.com, or on seveane.com for Sévéane partners.
Korelio presents itself as the professional’s single point of contact for third-party payment. The card confirms the insured person’s coverage rights and guarantees reimbursement by Korelio.
The Sévéane network is closed: a limited number of opticians per area, chosen according to a score (store, quality certification, lens traceability, equipment, services, lens prices, CSR).
Sévéane opticians commit to a maximum retail price for lenses, set according to the refractive error and the manufacturer.
The current Sévéane optical partnership contract covers the period 2024 to 2027.
Before its 2023 call for applications, Sévéane listed 11 lens manufacturers: BBGR-Nikon, Carl Zeiss Vision, Codir, Essilor, Hoya, Mega Optic, Novacel, Optiswiss, Rodenstock, Seiko and Shamir.
Outside the Sévéane network, an optician can offer Korelio third-party payment by signing the payment delegation agreement for optical expenses.
Coverage requests are made in the Korelio area. The browser must allow popup windows. For an approved coverage, a “Facturer” (Bill) button avoids sending a paper invoice.
In July 2023, Korelio asked opticians to renew their agreement online from their subscriber area to keep third-party payment.
On korelio.com, each store logs in with a username and the administrator account password, then a code sent by email. The device can be marked as trusted for 30 days.
On Korelio, an e-transmitted invoice appears in the “Demandes de prises en charge” (Coverage requests) list (status FACTUREE), not in the list of optical coverage approvals.

On seveane.com, login requires a username, a password and a 6-digit code received by email. A rejected username displays “Service momentanément indisponible” (Service temporarily unavailable), the same message as a real outage.

conventionnement: Sévéane network: submit an application on postulerseveane.com during a call for applications, one application per store. The last one took place in fall 2023.

Attach the documents: professional liability insurance certificate, store photos, optical revenue certified by the chartered accountant, AFNOR or Bureau Veritas quality certification, equipment photos, ADELI certificates and diplomas.
Between two calls, Sévéane only reaches out to opticians on its waiting list. Without a waiting list in an area, a mini call for applications may take place.
Korelio third-party payment: fill in the online membership request for the optical agreement, with your health insurance number.
Send the supporting documents through the area indicated by email.
Sign the agreement online, after Korelio reviews the file.
Create your account on korelio.com. A temporary password arrives by mail, to be changed at first login.
